reason: The orthorhombic rutile-derived average framework and approximate 6.566 x 6.385 x 9.196 A cell with Z = 4 are credible, and both submitted models are physically plausible, but exact structure recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable Rwp was supplied and the trajectory did not perform a demonstrated whole-profile refinement; it fitted a constrained Cmmm-derived framework to selected integrated intensities and compared only two of many enumerated O/F orderings, whose selective costs are close. Thus the submitted symmetry-constrained coordinates and discrete anion ordering remain unresolved, and materially different lower-symmetry or alternative ordering models could plausibly improve the candidate set.
